reason: Static delivery of the Metaform web page (gzip, versioned vendor addresses, immutable caching, modulepreload) carries module-identity and caching rules that break quietly if an editor misses them. The 2026-10-15 ticket 2e9686a7 introduced them and an agent would otherwise re-derive or break them.

A new worklet file added at the page root went through the same serving path, but the skill does not say how to verify it, nor that test_web.py's file enumeration covers only page/app. Recording both stops the next page-root file from being checked by guesswork.
Static serving rules are the metaform-web-ui Static serving section.
